summary: Approved. Feet are grounded on all 31 frames (max 0.01 clearance, floating 0, penetration 0, slide 0); the recovery hop and the foot swivel from iteration 1 are gone, with the twist now carried by the chest. The raised arm passes outside the head (f6-11), the blade stays clear of the head and ends forward above the floor (f15-20). The 15 accel spikes and 7 velocity corners sit on f10-15, the start and stop of the cut on the sword arm, wrist, chest and counter-swinging left arm, and read as the intended snap. Only polish remains.

findings.observation: The sword arm stops dead at f14 (rx -160 to -40 in 4 frames, then only 5 deg of drift to f18; velocity corner 5.17 deg/frame at f14). The follow-through is carried by the chest and wrist, which works, but a small overshoot-and-settle on the shoulder would soften the stop. Polish only.
